final_answer: The transformer architecture utilizes the self-attention mechanism to process sequential data and capture long-range dependencies without relying on recurrent structures. The self-attention mechanism dynamically weighs the importance of different tokens in the input sequence. The transformer model relies on computing query, key, and value vectors to achieve this. The self-attention mechanism is a key component of transformer models, allowing them to achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains and tasks.
